final: WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS invoice_total FROM invoice_counts), shares AS (SELECT c.order_id, c.invoice_count, 1.0 * c.invoice_count / t.invoice_total AS share FROM invoice_counts AS c CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.invoice_total IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares), above_mean AS (SELECT s.invoice_count, s.share, s.share - m.value AS excess FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_share AS m WHERE m.value IS NOT NULL AND s.share > m.value) SELECT SUM(invoice_count), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM above_mean
